headline: Sensex drops 548 points as Nifty falls to 22,363 dragged by IT and FMCG stocks

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Heavy selling in IT, FMCG, and financial stocks dragged the benchmark indices lower
PSU Bank and FMCG indices underperformed during the trading session
Sensex sank as much as 1,200 points from its day's high amidst broad profit booking
Market sentiment turned negative following recent multi-week losses and volatile global cues
whatHappening: Sensex closed down 548 points while Nifty 50 finished at 22,363
Goodluck India shares rallied 17% following merger announcements including its defence and green energy units
Tata Power Renewable doubled its Q2 FY27 capacity addition to 419 MW
Coal stocks at thermal plants held above 18 MT as supply deficit narrowed
summary:
Indian stock markets declined sharply on October 12, with Sensex shedding 548 points and Nifty ending at 22,363.
Sectoral indices including IT, FMCG, and PSU Banks faced strong selling pressure throughout the session.
Individual stocks like Goodluck India and Tata Power Renewable saw gains on company-specific positive developments.
